name: extract_url_content
description: Extract and clean text content from a URL (paper page, database entry, or any web page)
usage: from app.tools.biomni.literature import extract_url_content; result = extract_url_content('https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/7157', max_chars=5000)

parameters.url: str — URL to fetch content from
parameters.max_chars: int — maximum characters to return from the page (default 5000)

returns: dict with keys: url, title, content (cleaned text)
